responsibility: Implements the Rust HIR const-safety checker that validates constructs used in const contexts. By walking crate items, expressions, statements, and types while maintaining a stack of active const contexts, it diagnoses operations disallowed in const functions or constant initializers, checks whether called functions are const-safe, rejects mutable references in const fns, and enforces where default const-generic arguments are permitted across functions, type aliases, ADTs, traits, impls, and enum discriminants.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the const-checker pair: unlike rust-const-checker.h, it contains the concrete full-HIR walk, const-context stack handling, and emitted checks for const calls, mutable references, and default const-generic placement.
